setup: The set has \([[n]]\) elements, and the question counts its \([[k]]\)-element subsets.

steps.say: A subset of size \(k\) is a choice of \(k\) elements from \([[n]]\), with no order and no repeats, so it is counted by \(\binom{[[n]]}{[[k]]}\).
The whole power set has \(2^{[[n]]} = [[total]]\) members, since each element is independently in or out.
